rendered.subject: Collaboration Proposal - Instagram Post
rendered.body:
Hi Graza team,

We are a small Instagram content studio dedicated to crafting authentic and playful experiences for food lovers. We’d like to propose a collaborative Instagram post with you and Graza, built around the fact that Graza started Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) but also secured placement in grocers like Whole Foods, Target, and others [P8]. You’ve cultivated a social content strategy that’s distinctly flavorful and culinary-inspired, showcasing your unique design and messaging. Essentially, Graza’s social content, product design, and messaging are playful and culinary-inspired rather than overly formal [P7]. Dickieson estimated that Graza has added around 2,000 new social followers since launching the cans [P9].

We envision a collaborative Instagram post where you and our team create a visual piece that complements the first fact – a shared moment of visual delight. Together, we’ll craft a post that builds on the initial discovery and showcases the playful nature of Graza’s social content.

The BrandPilot team
